name: Glamdring
blocked_sentences: Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage to a player, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand with mana value less than or equal to that damage without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: an op that lets a player cast a card from their HAND without paying its mana cost, choosing it at resolution from a selector (here {"zone": "hand", "controller": "you", "types": ["Instant", "Sorcery"], "mana_value": {"<=": <bound>}}), optional ("you may"), and casting it on the spot rather than merely granting permission to play it later
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Every free-cast path in op_options is bound to a zone that is not the hand. `look_at_top` carries `cast_free` but only for cards it just revealed off the top of the library; `play_exiled` casts from exile, and its companion `exile` with `playable_this_turn` first has to move the card to exile, which would be a different, publicly-visible event and would not return the card to hand if it were not cast; `grant_playable` grants permission to PLAY objects (paying their costs) rather than casting one for free, and its `limit` counts plays, not a mana-value ceiling; `cast_copy`/`copy_spell` make copies of a spell already on the stack, not a card in hand. There is no `cast` op at all, so "cast ... from your hand ... without paying its mana cost" cannot be said without approximating it as an exile-and-play, which changes zones and card visibility.

needs.what: a value leaf readable inside a `deals_combat_damage_to_player` trigger's effects that yields the amount of damage that trigger's event dealt ("that damage"), so it can be used as the ceiling of a `mana_value` selector clause
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `condition_keys` has `combat_damage_by`, which can only ASK whether a given creature dealt combat damage -- it is a boolean, not a quantity. `value_keys` has `damage_taken_this_turn` (damage received, and per-turn rather than per-event), `power_of` (which is the creature's current power, not the damage actually dealt -- they differ under damage prevention, protection, or a blocker soaking part of it) and `mana_value_of` (which reads an object's cost, not an event). Nothing in `value_keys` binds the payload of the trigger event that fired, so even given a cast-from-hand op the mana-value bound could not be computed correctly.
